quotes.text: There's something both wonderful and slightly terrifying about decades of film history being preserved because one person at an auction happened to notice a folder full of old CD-ROMs
quotes.author: Ylano
quotes.source: Hacker News — In the wake of Tippett Studios' closure, a digital archive appears online
quotes.extraction_note: Pithy observation about how fragile digital history actually is — stands on its own as a nice insight.
